goa trance.name: Proto-goa
goa trance.note: New beat, EBM and acid house played on DAT at the Goa parties, predicting the sound.

sources.note: EBM, classic and acid trance as roots

goa trance.name: Origins
goa trance.note: The first goa trance records; Musicmap dates the genre to 1993.

goa trance.name: Golden era
goa trance.note: London labels (Dragonfly, TIP, Flying Rhino, Blue Room Released), Astral Projection, Hallucinogen, Juno Reactor; Oakenfold's Goa Mix.

sources.note: Early history of goa trance/psytrance list: to verify

goa trance.name: Transition to psytrance
goa trance.note: Sound turns more metallic; full-on, progressive and dark psytrance emerge.

goa trance.name: New school goa
goa trance.note: Revival with detailed production; Suntrip Records, Goasia, Artha, Morphic Resonance.

forest psytrance.name: Nordic roots
forest psytrance.note: Late 1990s and early 2000s in northern Europe: experimental, chaotic music inspired by goa trance and industrial sound, around the Swedish label Schlabbaduerst ReKkords.

forest psytrance.name: Tumult and the dark turn
forest psytrance.note: Popularised by Derango's album Tumult (2005); closer to dark psytrance, with sound effects ahead of melody.

forest psytrance.name: Swamp psytrance
forest psytrance.note: A slower strand influenced by downtempo, rarely above 135 BPM; no start year is documented.

sources.note: swamp named as a related style
